bullets: Changed: The Dev updates bell now sits next to the clinic name in full screen, and isn't in the side pane. A red dot means something new. Click the bell to read it; nothing pops up on its own.
Changed: The light/dark button shows the whole sun and moon again.
Changed: In full screen, the patient view's Needs card lines up with the main section.
Changed: In full screen, the patient view uses the whole width. Needs and Clinic notes sit on the right; Schedule, Protocol, Benefits and Financial are tabs above the section.
New: Add a note on the patient view. The box opens only when you press Add a note, and the note goes to Clinic Notes on the Master Patient Tracker with the date and your name.
Changed: Light/dark shows half of each symbol with a slash between them.
Changed: This bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
Changed: On Today, Action items are laid out like Treatment starts, the two start checks sit side by side, and the count is a pill (for example 3 open items).
Changed: Refresh, full screen and light/dark sit at the far right, with this bell right after them. Hover over any of them to see what it does.
New: Light/dark shows sun / moon. Press the one on the right to switch; they swap places when the mode changes.
Changed: In a narrow pane, the top bar shows Today, Schedule, Patients and Full screen. Everything else is in full screen.
Changed: On Schedule, each visit shows the patient and MRN on top, and the provider with the time underneath.
Changed: On Access, No-shows and Late cancels each sit over their own 30, 60 and 90 day columns.
New: Settings has Preview the start email, so you can see it with a sample patient before saving.
Changed: Settings › You no longer says who is at the desk. Teams posts use the name picked each day.
Changed: On Today, the time and date sit at the top left and the title on the right. Refresh, full screen and light/dark mode are at the top right, with full screen in the middle.
New: Full screen is also in the left menu, under your name.
Changed: The name screen now says "Enter your name", because anyone can be using the tracker, not just the front desk.
New: Drag this bell anywhere and it stays put. If a screen puts a button under it, it steps aside to the nearer side.
New: While a change is saving to the workbook, the cursor shows it's busy, a bar runs across the top, and the status at the bottom left spins.
Changed: The left menu shows the clinic name only. The bottom left shows whether the tracker is connected; hover over it for the workbook name.
New: Teams posts can tag people. Arrivals tag the RN, and protocol and scheduling asks tag the visit's provider. Set who gets tagged in Settings › Teams.

New: The provider can confirm the protocol from the Teams card ("Confirm 1x per week", or pick a different one), and it saves to the Master Patient Tracker. With a chair map loaded, the RN can change the patient's chair from the arrival card.

Changed: Check-in asks the provider to confirm the protocol when Protocol Updated is past its date, or when the patient has gone two of their intervals without a visit (every 2 weeks and not seen in over 4 weeks). A blank Protocol Updated still shows on Patients, but doesn't trigger the ask by itself.

New: Today has a Treatment starts checklist. When a new patient is booked for a start, tick Profile created to open their profile. On the day of the start, tick Case Management updated once you've moved them to 6. Started in NextGen.
New: The Consults tab now has Kept Start, CM Updated and CM Flag columns. A patient whose start was kept is taken off the waitlist and flagged until Case Management shows 6. Started.
New: You can record today's copay at check-in, and change it any time afterward from the visit card, even after check-out. At check-out you can also edit what the patient owes.
New: Click a visit on the Schedule to put the patient on a waitlist for a sooner date. After each appointment list upload, you'll be told when an opening fits.

New: Transfers are on the patient's Protocol page: discontinue them now, or schedule the transfer and confirm it at their last visit here. Upload a NextGen report that includes other clinics to see whether they're booked there.

Fixed: Schedule tiles now show the patient code and MRN instead of just a time. Start visits are flagged when the rest of the index isn't booked. Older NextGen files now upload, and Friday PM availability on the tracker reads correctly.
